notes.title: Infinity Challenge
notes.content:
Welcome to challenge yourself ad infinitum!

We've added a new game mode, the Infinity Challenge. It's an ironman mode, where your deck management is more limited, the monster are more numerous and harder, and you have no access to gear.

Features:

Three monsters every match
Graveyard is emptied after each match so you always start with your full deck
Divided into segments of five levels each
Monsters get more difficult every segment
A limited max deck size that increases by segment
15 new cards to select from after each segment, getting progressively better
A possibility to reroll your old cards during each new card selection
A random boon granted after the first level of each segment, along with one mana and health potion
Endless


Go test your mettle in the Infinity Challenge!

notes.title: Outsider's Staff Meeting -update
notes.content:
Greetings fellow travelers of the world of Rogue Cards!

We have finished an update that is likely to make you feel awesome.

Featuring:

 Tutorial is a little less hectic at the start
 Deck Manager: Hovering over a collection button now highlights cards in the collection
 Outsider drops a Staff if player doesn't have all of them (which means a max of 7 wins for ultra win!)
 You can see how many cards are in your graveyard during a match
 Lots of typos and small graphical bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Rogue Cards OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We are ecstatic to finally release Rogue Cards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39517211/2672d9b943ac9078df2f3934032f51f9519b8ce6.png
Out now on PC. Rogue Cards invites you to a deckbuilding master-class - can your strategy take you all the way to the Outer Planes and defeat the Outsider?

[previewyoutube=3wiPKwdggyw;full][/previewyoutube]
Have you ever felt like you were a peasant from a generic medieval time period destined to save the world? Are you skilled enough to challenge The Outsider - a god of the Outer Planes? Does your food taste bland in the morning due to lack of purpose? If you answered yes to those, or any other questions you might have, then look no further and venture out to victory!

Features

 Unique graveyard mechanic that challenges tactical and strategic gameplay
 Character and deck development over multiple runs
 Hundreds of cards, endless combinations
 Deck management tools to alter your gameplay from one encounter to the next
 Ultra rare cards from boss encounters that have truly astounding impact
 Enemies that remember killing you

Challenging tactical and strategic gameplay

 Monsters with multiple stages of attack
 Cards you play aren't automatically available for the next fight - choices matter!
 Cards that alter your character through the whole run
 Bosses that require unique approaches and give unique rewards
 Adjustable difficulty perks for those who want a truly hardcore challenge and the bragging rights to go with it


Get it now while stocks last!
Just kidding, it's just cheaper at launch, is all.

notes.title: 15 Sept release and upcoming features
notes.content:
Release is inevitable

We've been hard at work in making the game more fun and stable and have set a release date on 15 September 2023.

Testing will close on 15 Aug, so be sure to get your game on before that!

New features

We are currently working on two new features, which will go live to testing in the end of July.

Fervor system
Tweak gameplay elements for individual runs, making the game harder or easier! Bragging rights go to those who play with maximum fervor. Includes for example monster resist tweaks, damage type tweaks and coin drop tweaks. Think Hades' Pact of Punishment, but this goes both ways.

Character classes
We're introducing player classes. At first they will only affect starting deck and stats, but great things have been planned for them.

notes.title: Beta Test Open
notes.content:
BETA TEST OPEN NOW
Beta test can be accessed by anyone until we close taking new participants. Most likely we'll limit it to the first 500 or so.

During the test we mainly want people to play the game, but if you got feedback or feature requests or spot a bug, we'll be glad to hear it reported.

Our current focus is on balancing the early and end game and the itemization. We will be implementing new features and changing the balance as we go along, so remember to keep on playing. We've also got some graphics updates on the pipeline coming out this week or the next.

-Dapper Grim

notes.title: Rogue Cards - State of development
notes.content:
Been a while since we've posted anything, so I though I'd get you guys up to speed. 

Since the demo on Steam Next Fest, there have been quite a lot of changes to the core game. We've digested the feedback and we've added several new features into the game and we're working on testing them at the moment. I'll list them here in order of coolness (as judged by me):

Rival System

If you've ever played Middle-Earth: Shadow of ... games, you are pretty much up to speed. Certain bosses and mini-bosses in the game will develop different stacks and attacks as you get beaten by them, and this will also affect their card drops.

Card realms

Each realm will now have unique card drops (with unique graphics too) specific to that realm. So it will matter a LOT which path you take. And in order to collect those really wanted cards, you need to think more roguelite and less roguelike. We feel this adds greatly to the replayability of the game and adds a further twist into the decision making.

Stats

This was always a-coming, but you will now have access to a wide variety of stats from previous runs. For gloating or for personal interest, you decide.

In addition to those cool new things, there's been a lot of bug fixing, a complete rewrite of the core loop of the game (which took quite a lot of work!) so that the whole experience should be smoother and more intuitive.

We're still working on a tutorial and some graphics, and the music collection is getting a few pieces added to it. And of course, a lot of testing.

Stay tuned, I'll be announcing a semi-public beta in the upcoming months, before our Q2 (fingers crossed) release.

Best,
Grim Dapper

notes.title: First month
notes.content:
The first month
The alpha was released for testing in the beginning of January 2021. Our goal in this playtest is to tune the balance and iron out bugs. So far that's been going great!

We opted for doing small hotfixes as we saw them and as they were reported. The first month thus saw 7 updates, ending in a major update to the back-end logic that controls our statistics reporting and save games.

In our end, the statistics server functions as a real "who is who" and some of the data from it will be made public as we go forward. So in the future you can show of your skill to your friends!

We are still looking for more testers, so please join us before the testing slots are filled.

Visit us in Reddit to discuss the game!

Going forward

Our goal for the near term is to fine-tune the balance of the game. Currently the game is difficult, but is it hard enough? There might still be some bugs to fix, but they are getting few and far between.

We are eyeing at an artist to redo the whole visual image, but this will take time and to us is a goal in the medium term. As you can see, the game is currently running on placeholder imagery.

Full changelog

0.1.0. Major update

 Redid the save logic and statistics logic - this forces us to abandon old saves as they won't work with the new savegame type.
 Fixed a softlock bug with winning a match with a card drawing card. Thanks to Zarach for reporting.
 Minor adjustments to card playing visuals.
 Store now shows boons the player has been granted.
 New decks added.

0.0.6. HOTFIX

 When multiple enemies did a discard attack the discard text would stay on the match hud. Thanks to whitefroth for reporting.
 Fixed a bug with resurrection horn not sometimes working correctly.
 Fixed a bug with saves and statistics not displaying location with the correct name for bosses.
 Added several new starting decks as rewards.
 Adjusted several enemies.'

0.0.5. HOTFIX

 Massively adjusted the economy and shop pricing.
 Added Wasteland Champion game mode (unlocked with beating the game).
 Fixed functionality for beating the game.
 Fixed a bug with the End Turn button sometimes doing nothing.
 Fixed a bug with cards seen in statistics window not displaying correctly.

0.0.4. HOTFIX

 Fixed a bug with winning with a card that also allows return from graveyard or forces to discard.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes DOTs would be erroneously removed after stack death.
 Shop button enables for buying back cards and booster pack had bugs.
 Added a floating tooltip for cards in small mode (excluding deck manager).
 Deck manager windows tuned slightly.
 Fixed a bug where outer planes erroneously had a second necromancer.
 Fixed several cards.

0.0.3. HOTFIX

 Introduced "booster pack" in the shop.
 Reduced price for card returns in shop.
 Introduced some UI elements (boon granted popup, cards shown when buying returns or boosters in shop).
 Made card text a little bit larger and fixed the flicker that occurred on some resolutions.
 Capped  FPS at 120. Thanks to Laspa for reporting this issue.
 Fixed card texts:
 Sweeping magic hammer
 Introduced this changelog.

0.0.2. HOTFIX

 Fixed a bug where enemy buffs got redacted twice per turn.
 Mana potion didn't work as intended (gave max mana instead of current).
 Added "small mode" to graveyard selection during match.

0.0.1. Initial release
